fusions.name: Strangler Grip
fusions.desc: Seizes one enemy in a vine-wrapped grip for 14 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Buttress Slam
fusions.desc: Roots break the surface under every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 8 damage and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill restores one.

fusions.name: Liana Swing
fusions.desc: Swings you on a vine to a spot up to 7 tiles away. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Burled Knuckle
fusions.desc: When you land a weapon strike, you restore 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
